policy: Simulation-only project (decision DL-003). All experimental data are synthetic, regenerated from configs and seeds; raw outputs are not committed (results/raw/ is git-ignored).
notes: Any external dataset requires source URL or DOI, retrieval date, version, licence, redistribution status, SHA-256, schema, transformations, missingness and exclusions before use.
